zyraxon-authentication.implementation.de: The authentication implementation to use for signing in with a Zyraxon account.
zyraxon-authentication.implementation.en: Use the Zyraxon Authentication Library (MSAL) to sign in with a Zyraxon account.
Use the Zyraxon Authentication Library (MSAL) to sign in with a Zyraxon account using a browser. This is useful if you are having issues with the native broker.

zyraxon-sovereign-cloud.environment.desc.message: The Sovereign Cloud to use for authentication. If you select `custom`, you must also set the `#zyraxon-sovereign-cloud.customEnvironment#` setting.
comment: The `#zyraxon-sovereign-cloud.customEnvironment#` syntax will turn into a link. Do not translate it.

zyraxon-sovereign-cloud.customEnvironmen.message: The custom configuration for the Sovereign Cloud to use with the Zyraxon Sovereign Cloud authentication provider. This along with setting `#zyraxon-sovereign-cloud.environment#` to `custom` is required to use this feature.
comment: The `#zyraxon-sovereign-cloud.environment#` syntax will turn into a link. Do not translate it.
